caption: Centraal Station, Amsterdam
composition: IJ-side train shed, quay, and ferry pontoons · AI-generated artistic interpretation
description: From the IJ the north side of Amsterdam Centraal is a long iron-and-glass train shed behind the De Ruijterkade and the ferry pontoons. Dark water fills the foreground. The sky is overcast, about 15.7°C, with wind near 7.9 km/h. The ornate twin-tower facade faces Stationsplein, on the other side of the station, and is not in this frame.
